usage.query:
SELECT
  u.conversation_id AS sessionId,
  CASE
    WHEN typeof(COALESCE(u.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_at)) IN ('integer', 'real')
      THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(u.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_at) < 1000000000000
        THEN COALESCE(u.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_at) * 1000
        ELSE COALESCE(u.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_at) END
    ELSE CAST(strftime('%s', COALESCE(u.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_at)) AS INTEGER) * 1000
  END AS timestamp,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(u.model_id, ''), 'unknown') AS model,
  CASE WHEN json_valid(c.metadata) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(c.metadata, '$.workspacePath'), ''), NULLIF(json_extract(c.metadata, '$.workDir'), ''), 'unknown') ELSE 'unknown' END AS project,
  CAST(MAX(0, COALESCE(u.input_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(u.cached_tokens, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS inputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(u.cached_tokens, 0) AS INTEGER) AS cachedInputTokens,
  CAST(MAX(0, COALESCE(u.output_tokens, 0) - COALESCE(u.thinking_tokens, 0)) AS INTEGER) AS outputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(u.thinking_tokens, 0) AS INTEGER) AS reasoningOutputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(u.total_tokens, 0) AS INTEGER) AS totalTokens
FROM llm_token_usage u
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.conversation_id = u.conversation_id
WHERE u.conversation_id IS NOT NULL AND u.conversation_id <> ''
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, u.id DESC
